description: Conceal a secret file inside a cover file, returning a new sealed file without overwriting originals. File results are binary MCP resources; this connector rejects results exceeding its 140,000-character limit. Inputs require actual file bytes or reachable URLs.

cover_file.description: An explicitly supplied file. Provide exactly one HTTPS download URL or exact base64 bytes. Claude attachment IDs and local paths are not downloadable URLs.

private_seed.description: User-supplied Omniseal private seed. Never use an account password or API credential.

secret_file.description: An explicitly supplied file. Provide exactly one HTTPS download URL or exact base64 bytes. Claude attachment IDs and local paths are not downloadable URLs.

name: seal_files
title: Seal files
